noRoots:
No library roots yet.
Folders you add appear here.
firstLaunchBody: Sift indexes folders on your disks and drives. It only reads and catalogues files, never moves, copies, or writes to them.
firstLaunchHint: Indexing runs in the background. You can browse and play while it works.
emptyBody: Remove a filter chip, or widen the BPM range.
selectionDrag_one: Drag to your DAW to copy the file
selectionDrag_other: Drag to your DAW to copy all {{count}} files
missingBody: The path is gone. The volume <0>{{volume}}</0> may be unmounted. Preview and drag-to-DAW are unavailable, but metadata and tags stay in the index until you remove the entry.
noMoreTags: Every tag is already on this sample.
removeRootTitle: Remove this root from the library?
removeRootBody_one: Sift forgets the <0>{{formatted}} sample</0> under it, with its tags, overrides, and favorites.
removeRootBody_other: Sift forgets the <0>{{formatted}} samples</0> under it, with their tags, overrides, and favorites.
removeRootSafe: Nothing on disk is touched. Re-add the folder later to index it again, but the tags do not come back.
removeMissingBody: Its index entry, tags and overrides are deleted. If the file comes back at the same path later it is indexed as a new sample.
askIndexHint: You can keep browsing while this waits.
setBpmBody_one: Applies to {{count}} selected sample. Leave it empty to clear the value.
setBpmBody_other: Applies to {{count}} selected samples. Leave it empty to clear the value.
setKeyBody_one: Applies to {{count}} selected sample. Leave it empty to clear the value.
setKeyBody_other: Applies to {{count}} selected samples. Leave it empty to clear the value.
tagsDialogBody_one: Ticked tags are on the selected sample.
tagsDialogBody_other: Ticked tags are on every one of the {{count}} selected samples.
bpmNoDuration: Sift needs the sample's length to work this out.
